author: LINDA KOH
title: INSTRUCTION: Select the correct answer for each of the following questions

kids.content: INSTRUCTION: Select the correct answer for each of the following questions. Mark only one answer for each item by shading the box corresponding to the letter of your choice on the answer sheet provided. STRICLY NO ERASURES ALLOWED. Use pencil no. 1 only. MULTIPLE CHOICE:

list items.content: 1. It is the branch of physics pertaining to the phenomena and law of sound including the study of regulating sound and its reflecting properties. C. echo D. attenuation
2. The person who signs and seals plans for electrical for the purpose of obtaining a building permit. C. sanitary engineer D. structural engineer
3. An equipment for transporting people or things vertically or up and down the building C. dumbwaiter D. elevator
4. A process of treating air so as to control simultaneously its temperature, humidity, cleanliness and distribution within an interior space such as room or building.
5. A pipe, sheet metal or conduit fitting having a bend usually 90 degrees. C. tee D. wye
6. A duct used to transfer air from one location to another. C. viaduct D. air duct
7. A water outlet valve; also called a cock. C. faucet D. union
8. A unit of luminous intensity C. brightness D. light
9. A nipple having no shoulder and having the shortest possible length permitted by standard practice. C. open nipple D. 3” nipple
10. In a plumbing system, a branch in the shape of the letter Y C. wye branch D. split branch
11. Color-coding of plastic pipes and fittings for electrical conduit C. blue D. gray
12. A power-driven, inclined continuous stairway used for raising or lowering passengers C. stringer D. elevator
13. What does the letter “U” in UPVC mean? C. unglazed D. unplasticized

18. An over-current protective device consisting of a metal strip, ribbon or wire which is designed to open an electric circuit by melting if a predetermined current is exceeded.
19. An artificial reservoir or tank for storing water at atmospheric pressure such as rainwater collected from a roof for use when required C. area drain D. cistern
20. A structure, usually on the roof of a building, over which water is circulated so as to cool it evaporately by contact with air C. evaporator D. radiator
21. A short internally-threaded section pipe, used to join two pipes or conduits. C. nipple D. coupling
22. A lamp from which light is emitted when tungsten filament is heated to incandescence by an electric current. C. tungsten D. halogen
23. A device that redirects light or sound by reflection C. filament D. dimmer

34. The ratio of output into input C. power factor
35. Opposes the change in magnitude of an alternating current and makes the current lag the voltage C. cycle
